items.label: VIX at 26 — Risk-Off Regime
items.detail: VIX remains elevated at 26.15 despite Monday's bounce. Firmly in risk-off territory. Need sustained drop below 20 for regime shift.

items.label: Fed Hawkish Hold — No Cuts Before September
items.detail: FOMC held rates, Powell's Saturday speech reinforced higher-for-longer. Markets pricing zero cuts before September. PPI came in hot at 3.4% YoY.

items.label: April 2 Tariff Deadline (T-9 Days)
items.detail: Reciprocal tariff implementation on April 2. EU autos face 25% tariffs. No negotiation progress. DAX -4.54% weekly on tariff fears.

items.label: BOJ Intervention Risk — USD/JPY 158.63
items.detail: USD/JPY approaching 160 intervention threshold. Verbal warnings intensifying. Any intervention would cause Nikkei selloff and yen surge.

items.label: SPY Worst Week Since January (-3.3%)
items.detail: S&P 500 dropped from 677 to 655 in two weeks. Monday bounce +1.05% only partially recovered. 50-DMA at ~665 is key resistance.

items.label: Flash PMI Data — Make or Break for Bounce
items.detail: S&P Flash PMI Manufacturing (consensus 51.6) and Services (51.7) at 9:45 AM ET. Sub-50 = recession fears. Beat = relief rally extends.

items.label: Q4 Productivity Revision (1.8% est)
items.detail: Expected downward revision from 2.8% to 1.8%. Lower productivity + higher wages = inflationary pressure.

items.label: Fed Governor Barr Speaks 6:30 PM ET
items.detail: Barr is considered a moderate voice on the FOMC. Any dovish nuance could help overnight sentiment.

items.label: Consumer Sentiment Final (Friday)
items.detail: Preliminary reading 55.5, consensus for final 54.0. Declining confidence reflects inflation and tariff anxiety.

items.label: NPC Standing Committee March 30-31
items.detail: Chinese parliament meets next week. Potential fiscal stimulus above ¥1T. Could trigger rally in FXI, KWEB, BABA.

items.label: BTC Surges Past $70K — Testing $72K Resistance
items.detail: Bitcoin +3.56% to $70,260. Spot ETF inflows $420M Monday. Extreme Fear (11) historically precedes 30-day +18% rallies. Breakout above $72K targets $75K.

items.label: Gold Dip-Buy After -5.7% Pullback
items.detail: Gold at $4,358 bouncing from forced liquidation pullback. Central bank buying, weak dollar, geopolitical premium remain tailwinds. GLD $402-406 entry zone.

items.label: IWM +2.16% — Small-Cap Mean Reversion
items.detail: Small-caps most oversold with IWM 7% below 50-DMA. Monday's sharp bounce on strong volume suggests short covering underway.

items.label: Crypto Fear & Greed at 11 — Extreme Fear
items.detail: 3 consecutive days of extreme fear (8-11). Contrarian signal with caveats: macro headwinds reduce reliability.

items.label: DXY Below 100 Despite Hawkish Fed
items.detail: Dollar Index at 99.35 despite hawkish FOMC. Unusual divergence signals fiscal sustainability concerns. Supports gold, crypto, non-USD assets.

items.label: Risk-Off Regime Confirmed — VIX > 26
items.detail: VIX 26.15, Fear & Greed 11, put/call 1.15. Monday bounce was oversold relief, not regime change. Need VIX < 20 and SPY > 665 for neutral shift.

items.label: WTI Crude at $91.65 — Stagflation Risk
items.detail: Elevated oil prices add inflationary pressure. OPEC+ discipline + Middle East tensions keep supply tight. Bad for consumer discretionary, good for energy sector.

items.label: 10Y Yield 4.33% — Higher for Longer
items.detail: Post-FOMC yield repricing. TLT at $86.39 continues decline. Duration risk elevated. Rate-sensitive sectors (XLRE, XLU) under pressure.

items.label: EUR/USD at 1.16 — ECB Pause Expected
items.detail: Euro strength reflects ECB expected to pause at April meeting. Supports European exporters if dollar weakness persists.
